At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

This is a hands-on, on-site position that combines independent responsibility with close collaboration across teams, providing an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in workplace and facilities management within a QC laboratory environment. The role is primarily based at our QC Laboratory in Ballerup, with occasional support required at our headquarters in Valby.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and monitor work order requests, ensuring timely handling, follow-up, and resolution.

• Act as a visible representative of the Facilities & Workplace team, delivering excellent service and ensuring effective management of requests through ServiceNow.

• Support day-to-day workplace operations and contribute to the delivery of facility and administrative services, including assisting with the planning and execution of internal and external meetings, events, celebrations, and larger site gatherings.

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to support site operations and workplace initiatives.

• Perform additional tasks and projects as assigned by the supervisor to support departmental objectives.

Qualifications

• Currently enrolled as a full-time student, preferably within biotechnology, life sciences, or a related field.

• Minimum one year remaining of your studies.

• Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, including scientists, clinical teams, laboratory personnel, vendors, and service providers.

• Service-oriented mindset with a proactive approach, strong attention to detail, and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications; experience with ServiceNow and SAP is considered an advantage.

• Reliable, well-organized, and eager to learn and develop professionally, with the ability to work independently while managing multiple tasks and priorities.

What We Offer

• Practical experience in workplace and facilities management within a dynamic biotech environment.

• Exposure to cross-functional collaboration across laboratory, office, and operational teams.

• Opportunities to develop organizational, stakeholder management, and service delivery skills.

• A supportive team environment with meaningful responsibilities from day one.

DKK180,00---180,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

jobs.occupation: Quality Engineer, Automation and IT, at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energized by quality, validation, and complex Automation and IT projects in pharma engineering, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Quality Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AIT Quality Engineer, you’ll be:

• Leading CQV and validation activities for automation, IT, computerized systems, and equipment interfaces in GMP-regulated projects.

• Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.

• Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

• Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.

• Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent degree in engineering, IT, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.

• Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

• Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, ISPE guidance, data integrity, quality risk management, and validation lifecycle management.

• Ability to advise customers and project teams on validation strategy, compliance risks, and quality-related decisions.

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 27th November 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Rebecca Larsen at +45 31 91 88 47.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Head Chef for a New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Head Chef for a New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg

We’re opening an Italian restaurant in Esbjerg and looking for a Head Chef to lead our kitchen team of six. You’ll join us before opening, with a chance to shape the menu, organise the kitchen and build a team that works well together.

We want to keep the menu small and give each dish the attention it deserves. You’ll develop a focused selection of Italian dishes that make the most of seasonal ingredients. Alongside it, you’ll work with our pizza chefs on a dedicated Neapolitan pizza menu.

Your responsibilities

• 
Menu development. Create and test dishes, write recipes and help the team deliver consistent quality across every service.

• 
Team leadership and rotas. Plan shifts for the six-person team, assign responsibilities and make time to train and support your chefs.

• 
Daily service. Organise prep, cook alongside the team and keep service running smoothly when the restaurant is full.

• 
Kitchen finances. Cost dishes and work closely with management to keep track of food costs, labour hours and waste.

• 
Purchasing and food safety. Place orders, work with suppliers, manage stock and oversee food safety procedures.

About you

You have hands-on experience cooking Italian food and have led a kitchen team as a Head Chef or Sous Chef. You know how to turn an idea into a dish that tastes great, works during a busy service and meets its target food cost.

You give clear direction and lead by example. You notice when a colleague needs a hand, and you keep communication calm and respectful, even when the orders come in thick and fast.

What we offer

You’ll have a say in the first menu, how the kitchen is organised and how the team works together. You’ll work directly with management, with room to put your ideas into practice. Salary will reflect your experience and qualifications.

This is a full-time position with morning, lunch, evening and weekend shifts. The start date is flexible.

Interested in leading the kitchen? Apply through this listing with your CV and a few lines about your experience with Italian cooking and kitchen leadership.

**Help us bring AI from ambition to reality

**At AGC Biologics, we have reached an exciting point in our AI journey. The governance foundation is in place, several high-value use cases have been identified, and we are now ready to scale the development and deployment of AI solutions across the business.

To support this journey, we are looking for an AI & Data Solutions Engineer who can help turn business challenges into practical and scalable AI solutions.

This role sits within our Global Data, AI & Business Platforms organization and will work at the intersection of business, technology, and innovation. You will collaborate with stakeholders across AGC Biologics, partner with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, and contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of AI-powered solutions that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and business operations.

**What You'll Be Doing

**In your first months, you will be involved in several AI initiatives already identified across the organization. Some solutions will be developed together with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, while others will be built and deployed directly within AGC Biologics.

Success in this role requires someone who enjoys moving between business discussions and technical implementation. One day you may be meeting with stakeholders to understand a new AI opportunity and define requirements. The next, you may be preparing datasets, working on solution architecture, developing machine learning capabilities, or supporting the deployment of an AI solution into production.

You will work closely with our Data Engineering, Analytics, Solution Architecture, and Digitalization teams and play an important role in ensuring that AI solutions are technically robust, business-relevant, and ready for real-world use.

**What We're Looking For

Why this role exists

Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed. Practical

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data & AI Architecture, based in Copenhagen or London, to lead our team of four Data, AI and Solution Architects and serve as the design authority for Pandora’s Data & AI platform. This is a genuine dual role. You’ll set the architectural direction and standards, while remaining close enough to the technology to challenge, review and approve the designs that matter.

Our target architecture is Databricks, including Delta Lake, medallion patterns and Unity Catalog, while Azure Synapse and its conformed enterprise models continue to power a significant part of the estate across supply chain, commerce, manufacturing, corporate technology and omni-channel.

A critical part of the role is leading the transition to Databricks: shaping the target architecture, determining where ownership sits as the platform evolves, and ensuring existing solutions remain coherent and supported throughout the journey.

The role is approximately 60% architecture and 40% people leadership. You’ll lead and develop four architects, but this is not a role where technical accountability is delegated to the team. Both sides of the role are real, and you’ll be expected to lead both.

Scope and authority

• Design authority for Data & Analytics: approves data and AI solution designs, and can require rework, attach conditions to an approval, or withhold approval.

• Chairs the architecture review forum, setting its standards, cadence and quality gates, and deciding what requires review against what is already covered by an approved pattern.

• Resolves conflicting design positions across architects, lead engineers and delivery teams.

• Owns reference architectures, solution patterns, data contracts and architecture decision records — accountable for their adoption, not just their publication.

• Owns the team's roadmap, capacity allocation across workstreams, and budget, including engagement of external consulting resources.

• Translates and enforces the Data & AI architecture strategy set by the Global Director, and informs how it evolves.

Job Responsibilities

Architecture

• Set and enforce the standards for what is built on Databricks as the target architecture, what remains on Synapse for now, and what is retired — and on what evidence.

• Decide how data products are aligned: source-aligned versus domain-aligned versus consumer-aligned, where ownership and stewardship sit, and where a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) serves better than distributed ownership.

• Review technical designs from solution architects and lead engineers against platform standards; give feedback that changes the design, not just documents it.

• Define and evolve reference architectures, solution patterns and data contracts so that quality is built in rather than inspected in.

• Lead design sessions with architects, engineering and business stakeholders on complex or contested problems.

• Oversee transitional architectures through to legacy decommission, maintaining business continuity and closing the parallel run.

AI architecture

• Set and enforce architecture standards for agentic systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation, guardrails and observability.

• Set and enforce architecture standards for ML systems: feature reuse, training and serving topology, model lifecycle, and monitoring for drift.

• Approve AI solution designs with enough depth to arbitrate them on the technical merits, and in line with AI policy and applicable regulation.

Governance and regulation

• Embed privacy-by-design and personal data handling requirements into platform patterns, particularly across commerce and omni-channel.

• Maintain computational governance: data quality frameworks, contracts and lineage as platform capability rather than project effort.

Team leadership
